assessment: The sampled Bilibili danmaku P1 and AcFun internal page 1 have similar local camera/clothing/room and danmaku presentation at about 600 seconds. This supports a local content association for these sampled programme points, not whole-page equivalence, exact synchronization, continuity, or a shared mother-session date. Bilibili P1 and P5-P8 titles say 2020-01-03 (P1 explicitly says pre-chat); P2-P4 say 2020-01-12. The submission title and entry date say 2020-01-12. This confirms the earlier summary that P1-P4 all said 1/12 was inaccurate: only Bilibili P2-P4 carry 1/12 in their titles. The sample does not resolve whether the differently titled groups represent two sessions, alternate versions, or another relationship.
limitations: Only Bilibili pages 2 and 5, and AcFun page 1, were sampled; Bilibili pages 1, 3, 4, 6-8 and AcFun pages 2-4 were not checked.
No audio or private message text was transcribed; no contact details or lengthy danmaku text are included.
No independent mother-session date, whole-page match, continuity, or completeness is established.
The 2020-01-14 AcFun publication date and 2020-01-03 internal titles do not independently prove the live date.
